title: Fintech for Gen Z and Millennials

reader_summary.headline: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast. Millennials and Gen Z have been hard hit by the one-two punch of the 2008 and 2020 financial crises. That experience has radically shaped their approach to finances and their mindset around credit and debt.

key_points.text: This episode explores how fintech founders are now designing products tailored to the financial challenges that younger generation, from managing and avoiding student loans.
key_points.evidence_quote: This episode explores how fintech founders are now designing products tailored to the financial challenges that younger generation, from managing and avoiding student loans, to building credit, to saving and budgeting apps.
